I'm a product person who builds. For two years I designed, launched, and
supported my own products end to end: a generative-AI SaaS, a commission-free
restaurant marketplace, and privacy-first iOS apps. That meant doing every job
in the loop, from customer interviews and pricing to instrumentation, support
tickets, and the call to keep going or stop.

The habit I took from it is short loops. Talk to users, ship the smallest thing
that tests the real assumption, instrument it properly, then read what actually
happened. One product reached 23,000 monthly organic visitors and I still shut
it down, because the infrastructure economics never worked at that conversion
rate. Another grew to roughly 1,000 daily active users on word of mouth alone,
so it got my attention instead.

Before that I spent two and a half years at
[talabat](https://www.talabat.com) as an embedded product data scientist,
working alongside product managers, engineers, and designers across
Authentication & Onboarding, Home Feed, Search, Pickup, and Vendor. I defined
product metrics and health KPIs, ran the experiments behind launches in eight
markets, and gave go/no-go calls on features reaching millions of daily users.
On the Vendor side I partnered on a targeted discounts platform in Egypt and
the UAE that scaled past 15,000 daily orders within six months.

So I come to product from the measurement side, and I've since run the whole
thing myself. I can write the tracking plan, query the warehouse, and build the
prototype, which tends to shorten the distance between a question and an
answer.

I'm looking for a product manager, product owner, or founding role where
shipping and validating quickly matters more than managing a process.
[Get in touch](mailto:hamza-rabi@outlook.com).

## Experience

**Founder, Independent Product Development** · *Aug 2024 – May 2026*\
Built and launched four products across generative AI, restaurant technology,
and mobile. Ran discovery interviews, onboarded the first partners by hand, set
pricing, instrumented everything, and made the keep-or-kill decisions. A
generative-AI image SaaS reached 23,000 monthly organic visitors before I
discontinued it on unit economics; a privacy-first iOS music player is at
roughly 1,000 daily active users and 4.8/5 on the App Store.

**Product Data Scientist** · talabat, Dubai · *Mar 2022 – Jun 2024*\
Embedded in product teams across Authentication & Onboarding, Home Feed,
Search, Pickup, and Vendor. Defined product metrics and health KPIs to measure
feature success and guide roadmap decisions, led experimentation for launches
and growth initiatives, and built the event taxonomy and data models the teams
relied on. Partnered with the Vendor team on a targeted discounts platform in
Egypt and the UAE that scaled past 15,000 daily orders within six months.

**Data Scientist**, self-employed · *Oct 2020 – Sep 2021*\
Client work for a digital marketing agency, independent traders, and small
businesses: NLP topic discovery on Twitter data, predictive models and
backtested strategies, and analytics and reporting.

**Data Science Intern** · VINCI Energies · *Feb 2020 – Jun 2020*\
Electric load forecasting for commercial office buildings, benchmarking an
encoder-decoder LSTM against deep neural networks, Random Forest, ARIMA, and
XGBoost.

**Summer Engineering Intern** · NOVEC, 2019 · OCP, 2018
